publication: Asbury Park Sunday Press (The Shore Press)
summary: Page 2. Target item "Driscoll Aide to Address City Rally" profiles Melvin B. Johnson, public relations aide for the Driscoll for governor campaign (Newark headquarters), set to speak at a West Side Republican club rally at the Reindeer Rest. Johnson is described as a former editor and publisher of weekly newspapers in Montclair and Newark, now with the NJ Department of Labor and Industry's migrant labor division, and a close adviser to Gov. Driscoll on minority-group affairs since 1946. Rest of page is general state/national news (bond referendums, coal-steel strike, GOP dinner, obituaries) with no other Black-press content.
